text.donor_partner_volunteer_or: : donor, partner, volunteer or other — several allowed, separated by commas. A blank tag counts as other. Someone already in People with the same name and zip is updated (their address replaced, tags added) rather than added twice.

text.email_these_addresses_when: Email these addresses when someone submits a bug report or idea
text.keys_and_passwords_are: Keys and passwords are stored encrypted and are never shown again after saving; a backup restored onto another server loses them, so they would need to be entered again.
text.no_questions_yet_add: No questions yet — add presets or a custom question below.
text.none_yet_they_are: None yet — they are added from the Sorting page the first time a carton is scanned.
text.partner_accounts_can_log: Partner accounts can log in, but ordering isn't available to them yet.
text.port_465_connects_over: Port 465 connects over SSL; any other port switches to TLS when the server offers it.
text.provide_a_name_first: Provide a name (first + last) and/or an organization — at least one is required.
text.removing_a_carton_barcode: Removing a carton barcode doesn't touch any item or anything already sorted. The next time that carton is scanned, the Sorting page asks again what is inside and how many, and saves the new answer. To change an entry, remove it and scan the carton again.
text.role_pick_one_it: Role — pick one; it fully replaces the permission set below
text.scan_or_type_the: Scan or type the code from this person's physical badge, if issued — used for PIN-unlock badge scanning.
text.separate_addresses_with_commas: Separate addresses with commas. With none, reports are still saved, just not emailed.
text.set_a_password_now: Set a password now — the account is active and verified right away
text.set_this_when_this: Set this when this person is a contact at an organization already recorded above (checked "This record is the organization itself"), rather than a standalone donor/recipient/contact.
text.showing_the_newest_records: Showing the newest {{ records.length }} of {{ total }}.
text.someone_who_logs_out: Someone who logs out won't disappear from this list instantly — their session just stops updating and ages out of the

text.the_from_address_must: The From address must be on a domain verified in the Resend account the key belongs to.
text.the_test_email_could: The test email could not be sent.
text.they_said_they_re: They said they're here as a
text.this_changes_history_not: This changes history, not just the catalog.
text.this_is_a_self: This is a self-registered account nobody has approved yet — it cannot access anything but the pending-review screen until you approve it below, regardless of what role or permissions you set here.
text.this_record_is_the: This record is the organization itself:

text.you_ll_need_to: You'll need to give them the password yourself. It isn't shown again after you save.
